description: Java class implementing a file-based authentication service that loads user and role permissions from a JSON file, and provides methods for verifying user credentials and generating tokens.

classes.name: FileBasedAuthenticationService
classes.description: A service that authenticates users based on authorities loaded from a JSON configuration file, supporting plain and external verification methods, and token generation.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets the specific configuration for the authentication service.

methods.name: setTokenFactory
methods.description: Injects the token factory used for creating authentication tokens.

methods.name: doStart
methods.description: Initializes the service, loading permissions from the configured resource.

methods.name: loadPermissions
methods.description: Loads user and role permissions from a JSON resource specified in the configuration.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Reads data from a resource into a StringBuilder.

methods.name: parsePermissions
methods.description: Parses the permissions JSON object into internal data structures.

methods.name: parseRoles
methods.description: Parses roles from JSON and stores them.

methods.name: parseUsers
methods.description: Parses user data from JSON and stores it.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves user info by ID and mechanism.

methods.name: getAuthorities
methods.description: Constructs authorities for a user based on roles.

methods.name: toAuthorities
methods.description: Converts JSON authority specifications into Authorities objects.

methods.name: hasAuthority
methods.description: Checks if a user has a specific authority role.

methods.name: isAuthorizedToImpersonate
methods.description: Checks if a user has authority to impersonate others.

methods.name: verifyPlain
methods.description: Verifies username and password credentials and generates a token if valid.

methods.name: verifyExternal
methods.description: Verifies external credentials based on subject DN and generates a token if valid.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Generates a token for a verified user, supporting impersonation if authorized.
